LanguageData.BWT_PriorityOneDoneFirstExtended: Priority 1 is done first. Priority {0} is done last.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_ReturnToWorkTypes: Back to Work type - won't move
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_UseExpandedView_Tooltip: Keep the main Work columns visible and expand this Work's specific jobs beside it. This enables BWT's optional expanded presentation.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_UseFocusedView_Tooltip: Return to Better Work Tab's focused full-tab specific-job view and turn off the expanded presentation.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_Chooser_FocusDescription: Replace Work columns with this Work's specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_Chooser_ExpandDescription: Keep Work columns visible and expand specific jobs beside this Work.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_Chooser_SettingsNote: You can change this any time in Better Work Tab's settings.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_Chooser_AskAgainNote: You will be asked again next time.
LanguageData.BWT_SubWork_CtrlClickNotice_Text: You opened specific jobs with Ctrl-click. Make it your default shortcut for opening and closing them?
LanguageData.BWT_SkipIfPriorityForThisWorktypeAreadyA: Skip if this priority is already assigned
LanguageData.BWT_RuleName_Desc: A name to make it easier to tell what a rule does.
LanguageData.BWT_Priority_Desc: The priority to set the work type to. (Vanilla always assigns 3.)
LanguageData.BWT_Worktype_Desc: If assigned, this will be the only work type this rule applies to.
LanguageData.BWT_AllowOverwritingHigherPriority_Desc: By default the highest priority is kept. This allows later rules to overwrite higher priority.
LanguageData.BWT_HasHighestSkill_Desc: Assign pawns tied for the highest relevant skill. Vanilla instead assigns one random starting pawn to each Work type.
LanguageData.BWT_SkipIfAnotherPawnAssigned_Desc: If another pawn is assigned, do not apply to the current pawn.
LanguageData.BWT_IsPregnant_Desc: Only apply if the pawn is pregnant.
LanguageData.BWT_IsCapableOfViolence_Desc: Only apply if the pawn is capable of violence.
LanguageData.BWT_AssignToPawnWithFewestWorkPriorities: Assign pawns with the fewest existing priorities; ties are included.
LanguageData.BWT_HasChildOnMap_Desc: Only apply if the pawn has a child of learning age on the map.
LanguageData.BWT_IsNaturalAlwaysAssign_Desc: Only assign if Vanilla tags the work type as an "always assign" work type. (Vanilla always assigns these.)
LanguageData.BWT_RandomIfMultiple_Desc: If multiple pawns were assigned the work type, choose one at random to assign.
LanguageData.BWT_IgnoreIfWorktypeNonexistent_Desc: Only assign this work type if it exists. Used for modded work types.
LanguageData.BWT_IsTopXSkill_Desc: Assign when this Work type is among the pawn's top X skills. Vanilla uses the top six.
LanguageData.BWT_IsNthBestPawn_Desc: Only assign if the pawn is Nth best at this work type. It must be exact.
LanguageData.BWT_IsNthBestSkill_Desc: Only assign if the work type is this pawn's Nth best skill. It must be exact.
LanguageData.BWT_LimitNumberOfWorktypes_Desc: Only assign if the pawn does not already have this many Work types assigned.
LanguageData.BWT_SkipIfPriorityForThisWorktypeAreadyA: Only assign if this priority has not already been assigned for this work type.
LanguageData.BWT_PassionLevel_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's best relevant passion for the work type matches the selected passion.
LanguageData.BWT_SkillLevelGreaterThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's skill in the work type is greater than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_SkillLevelLessThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's skill in the work type is less than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_MoveSpeedGreaterThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's move speed is greater than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_MoveSpeedLessThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's move speed is less than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_Gender_Desc: Only assign to pawns of this gender.
LanguageData.BWT_Xenotype_Desc: Only assign to pawns with this xenotype.
LanguageData.BWT_RequiredTrait_Desc: Only assign to pawns with this trait.
LanguageData.BWT_AssignSimilarWorktypes_Desc: Also assign this rule to work types that use the same relevant skills.
LanguageData.BWT_FailedToApplyFallback_Desc: Apply this rule if the primary rule did not assign any pawns.
LanguageData.BWT_NoRulesForWorkType: No rules for this work type yet.
LanguageData.BWT_SelectWorkTypeFirst: Select a work type to edit rules.
LanguageData.BWT_SelectOrCreateRule: Select a rule or create a new one.
LanguageData.BWT_NoConditions: No conditions set. Click below to add.
LanguageData.BWT_Step1_Subtitle: Pick a column to configure rules for.
LanguageData.BWT_ShowOnlyConfigured_Tooltip: Only show work types that already have rules configured.
LanguageData.BWT_NoConfiguredWorkTypes: No work types have rules yet.
LanguageData.BWT_NoMatchingWorkTypes: No work types match your search.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_Welcome_Body: This tour assumes you already know RimWorld's Work tab and focuses only on what Better Work Tab adds or changes. You can pause at any time and return later. Optional feedback can be copied afterward; nothing is sent automatically.
LanguageData.BWT_Upgrade20_PromptBody: Better Work Tab was updated to 2.0. Your settings are preserved, and new features remain disabled to keep existing behavior. Tour the new features?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_ActiveBody: Fluffy Work Tab is active. Better Work Tab checked for compatible hourly priorities without changing visual or Work-tab ownership settings. Review compatibility settings?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_HistoricalBody: This save contains Fluffy Work Tab data. Better Work Tab imported compatible hourly priorities without changing visual or Work-tab ownership settings. Review compatibility settings?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_ActiveAndHistoricalB: Fluffy Work Tab is active, and this save contains its data. Better Work Tab imported compatible hourly priorities without changing visual or ownership settings. Review compatibility settings?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_SettingsContextToolt: Settings for Fluffy-style controls, saved hourly priorities, visible compatibility columns, and choosing which mod owns the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_DefaultContextHeading: Hover an option to learn more.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_Selector_DefaultBody: Click a highlighted pawn name, Work header, or priority cell to explore what Better Work Tab adds there.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnHub_Body: Better Work Tab adds a pawn action menu for dividers, custom titles, and row colors. Select one of those additions below.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnMenu_Preview: Right-click a pawn name to open its Better Work Tab actions.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnMenu_Action: Right-click the highlighted pawn name. The lesson completes when the pawn actions menu opens.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnDivider_Preview: Dividers label, separate, collapse, and visually organize groups of pawn rows.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnDivider_Action: Right-click the highlighted pawn, add a divider above or below, then confirm. The new divider completes the lesson.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnAppearance_Preview: The pawn menu can change the displayed title and row background color.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnAppearance_Action: Right-click the highlighted pawn and change its title or row color. The applied change completes the lesson.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderHub_Body: Better Work Tab makes headers interactive: reorder execution, move selected groups, or open specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderReorder_Preview: Drag a Work header to reorder execution. When priorities match, work runs from left to right.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderReorder_Action: Drag the highlighted Work header. Equal-priority work runs from left to right. The lesson completes when the order changes.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderGroup_Preview: Shift-click headers to select a group, then drag one selected header to move the group together.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderGroup_Action: Shift-click the highlighted Work header to change its group selection. Selected headers can be dragged together.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderSubWork_Preview: Specific jobs can focus or expand the grid, with priorities, overrides, reordering, and reassignment.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderSubWork_Action: Ctrl-click the highlighted Work header to open its specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderSubWork_Feedback: Specific jobs: presentation, priorities, and reassignment
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PriorityHub_Body: Better Work Tab extends these cells with skill-number views, daily schedules, and a configurable priority range.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PriorityHub_ShiftBody: Better Work Tab is showing the pawn's skill number while Shift is held. Choose “View skill number” for guidance on this added view.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderHub_SubWorkBody: Better Work Tab is showing this Work category's specific jobs. Repeat the shortcut or press Escape to return to the category view.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySkill_Preview: Hold Shift to display the pawn's skill number for that work.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySkill_Action: Hold Shift until the highlighted cell's skill number has been visible briefly.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySkill_SecondaryVisi: Your current skill-number settings can also show a smaller secondary skill number in the cell corner.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySchedule_Preview: Ctrl-click a priority cell to create a daily schedule with a different priority for each hour.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySchedule_ActionOpen: Ctrl-click the highlighted priority cell to open its hourly schedule.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySchedule_ActionEdit: Change at least one hourly cell by left-clicking, right-clicking, or scrolling.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PrioritySchedule_ActionClos: Your schedule change was recorded. Ctrl-click an hour cell to close the schedule and complete the lesson.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PriorityRange_Preview: Open the priority provider or maximum setting. Better Work Tab defaults to 1–9, supports 99, and preserves compatible providers.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PriorityRange_FilterTooltip: Priority provider and maximum-priority settings for the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_Unknown_Action: Return to the tutorial map and select an available lesson.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_RuleBuilder2_Preview: The rewritten builder uses focused cards, a live match preview, and an explicit application system.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_RuleBuilder2_Action: Build one decision at a time in the active card, check the preview to see who and what will match, then choose the target and application action. Previewing never changes priorities; only the explicit apply action does.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_RuleBuilder2_Feedback: Rule Builder 2.0 cards, preview, and application
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_Title: Better Work Tab and Fluffy remain active
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_Preview: Switch to Fluffy's complete Work interface and back while preserving Better Work Tab state.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_Action: Both mods remain active. The Work-tab owner selects the complete interface, while the specific-job presentation setting selects Focus or Expand Beside inside Better Work Tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_ActionSwi: Both mods remain active; this changes only the visible Work interface. Switch to Fluffy now. This lesson window will stay open.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_ActionRet: Fluffy now owns the Work interface, while Better Work Tab remains active. Return to verify its settings and column state.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_ActionPre: You returned to Better Work Tab. Its specific-job presentation and stored column order were preserved while Fluffy owned the interface.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FluffyCoexistence_ActionCha: You returned to Better Work Tab, but its stored presentation or column order changed. Please mention this in the lesson feedback.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_SettingsDiscovery_Preview: Search all settings, or open a focused configuration view from the Work-tab feature you are using.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_SettingsDiscovery_Action: Use settings search when you know a word, or right-click and use the settings affordance beside a Work-tab control to open only the relevant configuration. The routed setting is highlighted so you can see exactly what the control uses.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_SettingsDiscovery_FilterToo: Examples of feature, specific-job, priority, and Rule Builder settings that can be found by search or context.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_Review_Body: Feedback is optional and never affects progress. Nothing is transmitted automatically. Reports exclude usernames, save names, pawn names, and the complete mod list.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_DiscordCopied: Discord report copied to the clipboard.
LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_FullCopied: Full report copied to the clipboard.
